subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Reconhecer a existência de diferentes tipos de espaços amostrais, discretos ou não, e de eventos, equiprováveis ou não, e investigar implicações no cálculo de probabilidades.

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre espaços amostrais discretos e não discretos
components.description_en: Distinguish between discrete and non-discrete sample spaces
components.cc_component_description: Define a sample space and events within the sample space

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre eventos equiprováveis e não equiprováveis
components.description_en: Distinguish between equally likely and non-equally likely events
components.cc_component_description: Interpret smaller probabilities as less likely and larger probabilities as more likely, including probabilities near 0.5 as equally likely

components.description_pt: Analisar como o tipo de espaço amostral afeta cálculos de probabilidade
components.description_en: Analyze how the type of sample space affects probability calculations
components.cc_component_description: Understand that the probability of a compound event is the fraction of outcomes in the sample space for which the compound event occurs

components.description_pt: Investigar implicações da probabilidade de evento no cálculo de probabilidades
components.description_en: Investigate implications of event likelihood on the calculation of probabilities
components.cc_component_description: Understand that the probability of a chance event is a number between 0 and 1 that expresses the likelihood of the event occurring

cc_matches.description: Understand that the probability of a chance event is a number between 0 and 1 that expresses the likelihood of the event occurring. Larger numbers indicate greater likelihood. A probability near 0 indicates an unlikely event, a probability around $\frac{1}{2}$ indicates an event that is neither unlikely nor likely, and a probability near 1 indicates a likely event.
Understand that, just as with simple events, the probability of a compound event is the fraction of outcomes in the sample space for which the compound event occurs.

Describe events as subsets of a sample space (the set of outcomes) using characteristics (or categories) of the outcomes, or as unions, intersections, or complements of other events ("or," "and," "not").

prerequisites.description_pt: Reconhecer, em experimentos aleatórios, eventos independentes e dependentes e calcular a probabilidade de sua ocorrência, nos dois casos.
Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvem o cálculo de probabilidade de eventos em experimentos aleatórios sucessivos.

unlocks.description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas que envolvem o cálculo de probabilidade de eventos em experimentos aleatórios sucessivos.
